main.description: One package by publisher and slug. A withdrawn package is still returned, flagged `deleted`, because its releases stay resolvable.

actor.description: The publisher. A DID today: no library available to a registry script resolves a handle, so a handle is refused with UnsupportedActor rather than guessed at.

slug.description: The package slug, which is its profile's record key.

errors.name: PackageNotFound
errors.description: No profile is indexed for that publisher and slug.

errors.name: UnsupportedActor
errors.description: `actor` was a handle; give a DID.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry instance has no identity configured (HAPPYPROTO_DID), so it cannot read its own state. An operator problem, not a caller's.
